description: This file is part of the PyTorch distributed package. It implements functions and classes related to symmetric memory management and optimized collective communication primitives for distributed training, including enabling symmetric memory for process groups, low contention collective operations, and fused multi-operation kernels for efficient tensor sharding and communication.

classes.name: Work
classes.description: Represents a CUDA work object with management for synchronization, inheriting from _Work. It includes a CUDA event to track completion and provides a wait method.

methods.name: None enable_symm_mem_for_group(group_name: c10d.GroupName)
methods.description: Enables symmetric memory for a specified process group, creating and storing a PrefixStore associated with the group, and setting group info in _SymmetricMemory.

methods.name: bool is_symm_mem_enabled_for_group(group_name: c10d.GroupName)
methods.description: Checks if symmetric memory is enabled for the specified process group by looking up the store in a global dictionary.

methods.name: _SymmetricMemory get_symm_mem_workspace( group_name: c10d.GroupName, min_size: int )
methods.description: Retrieves or allocates a symmetric memory workspace for the specified process group that meets the minimum size requirement.

methods.name: get_remote_tensors
methods.description: Returns a tuple of tensors that are symmetric across devices within the same NVLink domain for a given local tensor and group.

methods.name: fused_all_gather_matmul
methods.description: Performs a fused all-gather followed by a matrix multiplication, optimized with pipelined communication, supporting different tensor layouts and scale modes.

methods.name: fused_all_gather_scaled_matmul
methods.description: Performs a fused all-gather followed by a scaled matrix multiplication with support for various scaling modes.

methods.name: fused_matmul_reduce_scatter
methods.description: Performs a fused matrix multiplication followed by a reduce-scatter operation across a process group.

methods.name: fused_scaled_matmul_reduce_scatter
methods.description: Performs a fused scaled matrix multiplication followed by reduce-scatter, supporting various scaling and output shaping options.

methods.name: torch.Tensor _low_contention_all_gather( tensor: torch.Tensor, group_name: c10d.GroupName, )
methods.description: Implements a low-contention all-gather using symmetric memory, optimized to reduce resource contention during overlap with compute.

methods.name: torch.Tensor _low_contention_reduce_scatter( tensor: torch.Tensor, reduce_op: str, group_name: c10d.GroupName, )
methods.description: Implements a low-contention reduce-scatter operation using symmetric memory with an efficient P2P based approach.
